name: Disable Touchpad While Mouse Is Connected
description: Disables the touchpad when an external mouse is connected to prevent accidental cursor movement on laptops.

description_i18n.en: Disables the touchpad when an external mouse is connected to prevent accidental cursor movement on laptops.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert den Touchpad, wenn eine externe Maus angeschlossen ist, um versehentliche Cursorbewegungen auf Laptops zu vermeiden.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le pavant tactile lorsque une souris externe est connectée pour éviter les mouvements de curseur accidentels sur les ordinateurs portables.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the LeaveOnWithMouse registry value under HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\PrecisionTouchPad to control touchpad behavior when a mouse is detected
